site.name: Victor Ginelli
site.description: Victor Ginelli is a founder and full-stack product engineer building payments, identity, mobile, blockchain, and community products.

projects.title: Send
projects.lede: Helped scale Send across web and mobile, supporting $53M+ in transfers, 70K+ passkeys, and 15 iOS releases.

screenshot.alt: Send website showing a customer using the mobile payments product
screenshot.caption: Send's consumer payments brand.

contributions.title: Virtual debit card
contributions.detail: Led the product from architecture through launch, connecting passkey ownership, identity checks, card issuance, funding, authentication, and card controls.

contributions.title: Community rewards
contributions.detail: Designed a gaming-resistant activity and token-distribution system that allocated 81M+ SEND, representing 27% of the community allocation, using behavioral signals, eligibility rules, and dynamic reward limits.

contributions.title: Web and mobile platform
contributions.detail: Architected a shared foundation for web and native apps that supported 1K+ Android downloads and 20K Sendtags.

contributions.title: Reliable payment operations
contributions.detail: Moved core payment execution into durable workflows for transactions, confirmation, reconciliation, retries, activity updates, and notifications.

contributions.title: Social payments
contributions.detail: Expanded Send with group payments, conversational sends, public activity, reactions, richer transaction details, and cross-platform notifications.

projects.title: Shenanigan
projects.lede: Founded Shenanigan to help athletes earn from their work while keeping control of their identity and assets.

screenshot.alt: PANTS product page showing digital clothing available to buy
screenshot.caption: PANTS turned community energy into added runway.

contributions.title: Athlete and fan platform
contributions.detail: Built an experience for athletes to create and livestream challenges, receive direct support, and build fan communities and collectibles.

contributions.title: Dripp and $PANTS
contributions.detail: Created Dripp, a cross-community rewards system where supporters staked $PRTCLE, supplied liquidity, and earned redeemable $PANTS. The campaign extended Shenanigan’s runway by 12 months.

contributions.title: $PRTCLE fundraising
contributions.detail: Paired Gitcoin fundraising with token incentives that brought supporters into Shenanigan and contributed to a $100K+ community raise.

contributions.title: Company leadership and community governance
contributions.detail: Led six recurring contributors and two contractors, and designed public governance and contribution rewards around measurable participation.

projects.title: BrightID Bot
projects.lede: Turned a weekend prototype into a service that verified 11,000+ people in one year.

screenshot.alt: BrightID Bot dashboard for Discord community verification
screenshot.caption: A simple dashboard for community verification.

contributions.title: Prototype to product
contributions.detail: Turned a weekend hackathon prototype into a production identity-verification service for online communities.

contributions.title: Verification at scale
contributions.detail: Led the service as it verified more than 11,000 people in one year.

contributions.title: Deployment migration
contributions.detail: Moved the production service from Heroku to Railway for its next stage of operation.

contributions.title: BrightID infrastructure
contributions.detail: Operated a dedicated BrightID node supporting the bot's verification flow.
